parts.label: a
hints: The cumulative probability is $\text{P}(X < 18) = 0.10 < 0.50$, so the boundary is below the mean and $z = -1.282$.
Set up the standardisation formula $\frac{18 - \mu}{3} = -1.282$ and solve for $\mu$.

walkthrough.text:
Identify that the cumulative area is 0.10, which corresponds to the negative critical value $z = -1.282$:
$$\text{P}(Z < z) = 0.10 \implies z = -1.282$$

Set up the standardisation equation and solve for $\mu$:
$$\frac{18 - \mu}{3} = -1.282 \implies 18 - \mu = -3.846 \implies \mu = 18 + 3.846 = 21.846 \approx 21.8$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Recognise the lower tail area of 0.10 and equate standard score:
$$\frac{18 - \mu}{3} = -1.282$$

Solve for the mean $\mu$ to 3 significant figures:
$$\mu = 18 + 3(1.282) = 21.8$$

ai_rubric.observable: Identify negative z-score z = -1.282 and form standardisation equation (18 - mu) / 3 = -1.282.

teacher_walkthrough.text:

$$\frac{74 - \mu}{5} = 0.842$$

ai_rubric.observable: Identify z-score z = 0.842 for cumulative area 0.80 and form (74 - mu) / 5 = 0.842.

parts.label: a
hints: Convert the upper tail condition $\text{P}(X > 92) = 0.10$ to cumulative area $\text{P}(X < 92) = 0.90$.
This gives $z = 1.282$. Set up $\frac{92 - 80}{\sigma} = 1.282$ and solve for $\sigma$.

walkthrough.text:
Convert the upper tail probability into a cumulative probability:
$$\text{P}(X > 92) = 0.10 \implies \Phi(z) = 1 - 0.10 = 0.90 \implies z = 1.282$$

Formulate the equation for $\sigma$ and solve:
$$\frac{92 - 80}{\sigma} = 1.282 \implies \frac{12}{\sigma} = 1.282 \implies \sigma = \frac{12}{1.282} = 9.3603 \approx 9.36$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Translate the upper 10% condition to standard score:
$$z = 1.282, \quad \frac{92 - 80}{\sigma} = 1.282$$

ai_rubric.observable: Convert upper tail P(X > 92) = 0.10 to cumulative 0.90 to obtain z = 1.282 and form (92 - 80) / sigma = 1.282.

parts.label: a
hints: Since $\text{P}(Y < 41) = 0.15 < 0.50$, the $z$-score is negative. By symmetry, look up area $0.85$ to find $z = -1.036$.

walkthrough.text:
Find the negative $z$-score corresponding to cumulative probability 0.15:
$$\Phi(-z) = 1 - 0.15 = 0.8500 \implies -z = 1.036 \implies z = -1.036$$

Set up the standardisation equation and solve for $\sigma$:
$$\frac{41 - 50}{\sigma} = -1.036 \implies \frac{-9}{\sigma} = -1.036 \implies \sigma = \frac{-9}{-1.036} = 8.6872 \approx 8.69$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Recognise the lower tail area 0.15 gives $z = -1.036$:
$$\frac{41 - 50}{\sigma} = -1.036$$

Divide the negative difference by the negative score to yield a positive spread:
$$\sigma = \frac{-9}{-1.036} = 8.69$$

ai_rubric.observable: Find z = -1.036 for cumulative area 0.15 and form (41 - 50) / sigma = -1.036.

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Express the bottom 5% boundary as a negative $z$-score:
$$\frac{1.1 - \mu}{0.4} = -1.645$$

ai_rubric.observable: Convert P(T > 1.1) = 0.95 to cumulative P(T < 1.1) = 0.05 to obtain z = -1.645 and form (1.1 - mu) / 0.4 = -1.645.
Solve for mu to obtain 1.76 hours (or 1.758).

parts.label: a
hints: 'Fail before 1050 hours' means cumulative area $\text{P}(T < 1050) = 0.10$, giving $z = -1.282$.

walkthrough.text:
Identify the cumulative probability statement and corresponding $z$-score:
$$\text{P}(T < 1050) = 0.10 \implies z = -1.282$$

Solve for the standard deviation $\sigma$:
$$\frac{1050 - 1200}{\sigma} = -1.282 \implies \frac{-150}{\sigma} = -1.282 \implies \sigma = \frac{-150}{-1.282} = 117.004 \approx 117\text{ hours}$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Set up the lower tail equation:
$$\frac{1050 - 1200}{\sigma} = -1.282$$

ai_rubric.observable: Find z = -1.282 for cumulative area 0.10 and set up (1050 - 1200) / sigma = -1.282.

parts.label: b
hints: Standardise the threshold 1350 hours using $\mu = 1200$ and $\sigma = 117.0$.
Express the upper tail as $1 - \Phi(1.282)$ and evaluate using the critical value table.

walkthrough.text:
Standardise the lifetime 1350 hours:
$$z = \frac{1350 - 1200}{117.0} = \frac{150}{117.0} = 1.282$$

Express the upper tail probability:
$$\text{P}(T > 1350) = 1 - \Phi(1.282)$$

Recall that $\Phi(1.282) = 0.9000$, and evaluate:
$$1 - 0.9000 = 0.1000 \approx 0.100 \text{ (or } 0.10\text{)}$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Find the standardised score for 1350 hours:
$$z = \frac{150}{117} = 1.282$$

Notice by symmetry that this is the mirror of the lower 10% tail:
$$\text{P}(T > 1350) = 1 - \Phi(1.282)$$

parts.label: a
hints: Given $\text{P}(X < 72.0) = 0.75$, look up the upper quartile critical value $z = 0.674$.
Rearrange to $72.0 = \mu(1 + 0.2 \times 0.674)$ to solve for $\mu$, then evaluate $\sigma = 0.2\mu$.

walkthrough.text:
Identify the $z$-score for the 75th percentile and set up the equation with $\sigma = 0.2\mu$:
$$\Phi(z) = 0.75 \implies z = 0.674, \quad \frac{72.0 - \mu}{0.2\mu} = 0.674$$

Solve for the mean $\mu$:
$$72.0 - \mu = 0.1348\mu \implies 1.1348\mu = 72.0 \implies \mu = \frac{72.0}{1.1348} = 63.447 \approx 63.4\text{ kg}$$

Calculate the standard deviation $\sigma$:
$$\sigma = 0.2\mu = 0.2 \times 63.447 = 12.689 \approx 12.7\text{ kg}$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Use the stated relationship $\sigma = 0.2\mu$ to form a single variable equation:
$$\frac{72 - \mu}{0.2\mu} = 0.674$$

ai_rubric.observable: Find z = 0.674 for cumulative area 0.75 and substitute sigma = 0.2*mu to form (72.0 - mu) / (0.2*mu) = 0.674.
Solve for mu to obtain 63.4 kg (or 63.45).

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Compute standard scores for 55.0 kg and 75.0 kg:
$$z_1 = -0.666, \quad z_2 = 0.910$$

Set up the probability formula using positive entries:
$$\Phi(0.910) + \Phi(0.666) - 1$$

ai_rubric.observable: Formulate interval probability as Phi(0.910) + Phi(0.666) - 1.

parts.label: c
hints: Let $Y$ be the number of journeys qualifying for compensation out of 8, so $Y \sim \text{B}(8, 0.080)$.
'At least one' is the complement of none: $\text{P}(Y \ge 1) = 1 - \text{P}(Y = 0)$.

walkthrough.text:
Model the count of qualifying journeys as a Binomial distribution and express the complement:
$$Y \sim \text{B}(8, 0.080), \quad \text{P}(Y \ge 1) = 1 - \text{P}(Y = 0)$$

Calculate the zero-success probability term:
$$\text{P}(Y = 0) = (0.920)^8 = 0.513219$$

Subtract from 1 to obtain the answer:
$$\text{P}(Y \ge 1) = 1 - 0.513219 = 0.486781 \approx 0.487$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Formulate using binomial complement of 0 successes:
$$\text{P}(Y \ge 1) = 1 - (0.92)^8$$

ai_rubric.observable: Recognise binomial model Y ~ B(8, 0.080) and complement formulation 1 - P(Y = 0).
